case_classification.short_description: Loan Amortization Schedule for an Annuity Loan

ai_time_estimate_reasoning: This task requires building a highly precise, dynamic amortization schedule with semi-monthly payments, monthly compounding, and payments at the beginning of each period (annuity due). An expert modeler needs to calculate the correct semi-monthly equivalent interest rate, handle semi-monthly date logic (switching between the 1st and 15th of each month), implement the correct annuity due payment formula with a non-zero salvage/remaining balance, and set up lookups and SUMIFS to answer the 25 specific questions across various dates and years.
